title: eBird Checklist Status Mix
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ebird:checklist
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(checklist_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the eBird checklist feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `checklist_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It finds the overall mood of your eBird checklist feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
